persona: Fresh independent ordinary user/toolchain reviewer: decide whether the exact first useful Rust LSP diagnostics slice, actual Rust checker/profile routing, dependency policy and public CLI regression meet the preserved DevEx/EARS requirements without overstating compiler/native/release support. scope: Unadopted ordinary Rust LSP diagnostics transport/types/profile/protocol design only; no execution/security judgment

providerMetadataQualification: topLevelProviderMetadata contains only provider-envelope system/init/result fields. Recursive actualProviderMetadata may include names in quoted source/tool results and is not sufficient by itself for identity qualification.
